dataset: user_001 archival batch; physical author identity unconfirmed
split: existing deterministic character hash, train 60%, dev 20%, test 20%; all repeats same group
profile: training records only, retain full raw source channel; never build target profiles
reference_selection: exact component evidence first; otherwise same public geometric signature (hook, capped turns, aspect), public normalized stroke distance <=0.20, nearest 8 different characters, one public stroke per character, repeats averaged; target and donor character excluded
reference_confidence: at least 4 reference characters per scored stroke, circular resultant length at least 0.5; use common supported strokes across candidates
geometry: unchanged D candidates, safety, whole-component isotropic placement and full raw vertices
development_selection: lowest terminal angle with geometry at most 1.01 times D, activation unchanged; require strictly lower terminal angle, ties prefer smaller weight then author mode; else D
confirmation: run test only after positive dev freeze; no retuning; aggregate each capture, then within character, then across characters
target_eligibility: all dev/test characters with a public compatible component; choose slot with most candidates then component path, before inspecting target captures
stroke_semantics: public stroke_type is absent; geometric signature is not a semantic calligraphic label
development_history: context-only v1 has no supported references; hierarchical development is a separate declared extension using same dev group; test remains untouched
